title: Junior Blockchain Developer
description: Entry-level blockchain developer focusing on foundational distributed systems, writing and unit-testing standard ERC-20/721 smart contracts in Solidity, using Foundry/Hardhat, integrating wallets via Wagmi/Viem, and testing on public testnets.

skills.rationale: Writing clean Solidity contracts and implementing ERC-20/721 standards is core for daily work.
Using Foundry and Hardhat for compiling, testing, and script deployments.
Connecting frontend DApps to Web3 wallets with Wagmi and interacting with RPCs.
Understanding the blockchain data structure, UTXO/account models, and transaction lifecycle.
Applying OpenZeppelin security contracts and avoiding basic vulnerabilities like reentrancy.
Grasping asymmetric cryptography, ECDSA signatures, and BIP-39 wallet derivation.
Navigating EVM testnets, RPC providers, and block explorer verification.
Basic gas profiling and understanding Layer 2 rollups concepts.

scoring.description: Weighted average of skill readiness scores multiplied by importance weights.

partially_ready.description: Writes basic contracts but struggles with Foundry testing or wallet hooks.

ready.description: Competent junior developer delivering tested ERC contracts and Wagmi DApp frontends.

exceeds.description: Exceeds junior expectations with strong grasp of L2s and gas optimization.
